reason: I've cooked basil pork, omelets, tom yum and green curry from market paste for my family for years without looking anything up, and when I want something new I watch a free clip or ask my mother. I'm not going to pay every month for recipes.
objection: Will a new dish really come out right with the ingredients from my market and my own stove? If it flops, the kids won't eat it and the money for the ingredients is gone, and having the chef go through it with me afterwards doesn't give that back.
would_change_my_mind: Paying once instead of every month, for cheap Sunday cook-ahead dishes that feed my family for the week.
